system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 25. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (21 seconds, code score 0.87) ---
[b00] JULIANA (gentle, perplexed): "Alexander... why are you so angry?"
[b01] ALEXANDER (fierce, reproachful): "Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me."
[b02] JULIANA (vulnerable): "I knew you would worry."
[b03] ALEXANDER (furious, tormented): "Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you."
[b04] JULIANA (defiant, soothing): "But they didn't."
[b05] ALEXANDER (grim, fearful): "This time."

--- WINDOW 1 (35 seconds, code score 0.80) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (fierce, urgent): "Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?"
[b01] JULIANA (earnest): "I went there to help someone."
[b02] ALEXANDER (blunt): "Who?"
[b03] JULIANA (solemn): "The Dowager Duchess."
[b04] ALEXANDER (stunned, disbelieving): "The Dowager?"
[b05] JULIANA (urgent): "Prudence told me she was dying."
[b06] JULIANA (fervent): "She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old."
[b07] JULIANA (chilling, definite): "But it wasn't age."
[b08] ALEXANDER (grim, low): "What did you find?"
[b09] JULIANA (hushed, horrified): "Poison."

--- WINDOW 2 (34 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] JULIANA (strained, minimizing): "It is nothing."
[b01] ACTION: Alexander's gloved fingers pull back the torn fabric of her cloak and sleeve, revealing a raw, bloody welt slashing across her bare shoulder.
[b02] ALEXANDER (seething, dangerous): "Who did this?"
[b03] JULIANA (subdued, weary): "It does not matter."
[b04] ALEXANDER (demanding, stern): "Who?"
[b05] ACTION: Alexander steps directly into her space, firmly taking her hand in his.
[b06] JULIANA (quiet, apprehensive): "Lady Catherine."
[b07] ALEXANDER (low, interrogating): "Where did you meet her?"
[b08] JULIANA (hedged): "I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid."
[b09] ALEXANDER (incredulous, demanding): "What were you doing there?"
[b10] ALEXANDER (fierce, urgent): "Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?"

--- WINDOW 3 (56 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (grim, low): "What did you find?"
[b01] JULIANA (hushed, horrified): "Poison."
[b02] JULIANA (sober): "Arsenic."
[b03] ACTION: Alexander's hand drops to his side and clenches into a white-knuckled fist, the thick scar across his hand tightening with intense restraint.
[b04] JULIANA (pained, troubled): "Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly."
[b05] JULIANA (sincere, earnest): "I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier."
[b06] ALEXANDER (incredulous): "You treated her?"
[b07] JULIANA (firm): "Yes."
[b08] ALEXANDER (tense): "Alone?"
[b09] JULIANA (soft): "With Prudence."
[b10] ALEXANDER (anxious): "Will you be going there again?"
[b11] JULIANA (determined): "I have to."
[b12] JULIANA (pleading, defiant): "She is still sick. I cannot leave her there."
[b13] ACTION: Juliana places her gentle hand against Alexander's broad chest, trying to soothe his rising anger.
[b14] ACTION: Alexander takes both of her hands into his own, gripping them tightly.
[b15] JULIANA (gentle, perplexed): "Alexander... why are you so angry?"
[b16] ALEXANDER (fierce, reproachful): "Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me."

Pick the single best promo.
